steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's buyer Responses tab, where the vendor bid and vertical-switch control are available.
Enable eRFX projects for the RFQ scenario.
Keep counter offers visible on RFQs as required by the case configuration.
Allow bid-rejection controls during bidding as required by the configured scenario.
Enable buyer editing of bidding fields for this scenario.
Enable percentage-based counter offers for the configured RFQ.
Activate the response grid's vertical-switch control.
Verify the switched view shows the expected numbered product, material code, and variant.
Verify the switched view shows the requested quantity and delivery location.
